- [Confetti & Co. — Event styling & party rentals in Troy, MO | River City Digital Co.](https://rivercitydigitalco.com/work/confetti-and-co): A bright, bookable site for a family-run party styling business — balloon garlands and luxury teepee sleepovers across the St. Louis metro
